query:
UPDATE store_products SET
            author_name = $1,
            city = $2,
            country = $3,
            region = $4,
            nearest_mountain = $5,
            nearest_river = $6,
            natural_park = $7,
            altitude_meters = $8,
            season = $9,
            weather_conditions = $10,
            camera_info = $11,
            date_taken = $12
        WHERE id = $13
